verdict.rationale: Anytype ships a first-party local API and an official MCP server (documented explicitly) plus an 'Agents skill' toolkit that lets AI assistants like Claude Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot read/search/modify Anytype objects, directly matching the story's ask for first-party connectors/AI-plugin ecosystem support. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification that these integrations work reliably in practice, and evidence of a broader third-party AI plugin ecosystem beyond the explicitly named agent tools.
